name: Word 文档
description: 在 IDE 里打开和编辑 Word（.docx）：按原样式显示（样式、编号列表、表格、图片、页眉页脚），直接打字修改，设置字体、字号、颜色、突出显示、对齐、行距、标题样式、项目符号和编号，插入表格（增删行列）、图片（可拖动缩放）、超链接、分页符，查找替换，导航窗格。保存时只改动修改过的部分，批注、修订、域、脚注等原样保留，保存的文件可以直接用 Word、WPS 打开。IDE 里的 AI 助手可以读取文档、用 Markdown 插入内容、查找替换、改段落格式、编辑表格、插入图片。

agentTools.name: getDocument
agentTools.description: Read the Word document as numbered blocks (paragraphs and tables, 1-based, in order). Each paragraph: style name, list info (bullet / number, level, label), alignment, text ([image] marks pictures, \t tabs, \n line breaks), page / section breaks. Tables: their cell texts. Also the page size and margins (pt) and the paragraph styles available. Block numbers are used by the other tools. Long documents: pass from / to (block numbers).

to.description: Last block to return. Default: the last block (at most 400 per call).

agentTools.name: insertContent
agentTools.description: Insert content written in Markdown. Every non-empty line becomes its own paragraph. Supported: # … ###### headings (Heading 1-6 styles), - / * bullets and 1. numbered lists (indent 2 spaces per level), > quotes, ``` code blocks, | pipe | tables | (a --- separator row makes the first row a header), --- horizontal rule, <!-- pagebreak --> page break; inline **bold**, *italic*, ~~strike~~, `code`, [text](https://link), <u>underline</u>. Position: after (block number, 0 = at the start) or before; default at the end. replace: block range to replace with the new content (e.g. "4-6"). style: paragraph style for plain lines (e.g. "Normal", or a style name from docx_getDocument). An empty new document is replaced.

agentTools.name: replaceText
agentTools.description: Find and replace text across the document (including tables), keeping the formatting of the original text. Matches cannot span tabs, line breaks or pictures. regex: treat `find` as a JavaScript regular expression ($1 in `replace` refers to groups). all: false replaces only the first match. blocks: limit to a block range.

agentTools.name: editParagraphs
agentTools.description: Change paragraphs (block range, e.g. "3" or "3-5,8"). text: replace the paragraph text (inline Markdown **bold** etc. allowed; keeps the paragraph style and the formatting of its first run). style: paragraph style ("Heading 1", "Title", "Normal", "Quote" or any name from docx_getDocument). align: left / center / right / justify. list: bullet / number / none, level 1-9. Text formatting applied to the whole paragraph: bold, italic, underline, strike, color (#rrggbb), highlight (#rrggbb or "none"), size (pt), font. Paragraph layout in pt: indentLeft, firstLineIndent (negative = hanging), spacingBefore, spacingAfter; lineSpacing as a multiple (1, 1.5, 2); pageBreakBefore. Tables in the range only take text formatting.

agentTools.name: deleteBlocks
agentTools.description: Delete paragraphs / tables by block range, e.g. "7" or "7-9,12".

agentTools.name: editTable
agentTools.description: Edit a table (its block number). action: setCells {cells: rows of cell texts written starting at row / column (1-based, default 1); rows and columns are added when needed; \n starts a new paragraph in a cell; header: true makes the first row a bold repeating header}; insertRows {row: the new rows' position (default: at the end), count, cells: texts of the new rows}; deleteRows {row, count}; insertColumns {column (default: at the end), count}; deleteColumns {column, count}; delete. New tables: use docx_insertContent with a Markdown table.

agentTools.name: insertImage
agentTools.description: Insert a picture (png, jpg, gif, bmp, webp, svg; path relative to the workspace root) as its own paragraph. width in pt (default: natural size, at most the text width); align left / center / right (default center); optional caption paragraph below. Position: after / before a block number (after 0 = at the start); default at the end.

agentTools.name: screenshot
agentTools.description: Pass `block` to scroll that block into view first.
